title: 第699章 你不是师尊第698章 不该出现的人
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
“师尊！这……这究竟是怎么回事？！”
虽然眼前之人是自己的师父，但南宇辰此刻却有些慌，这太不正常了，师尊怎么会突然出现在这种荒山野岭，还和一个诡异的小女孩这么亲近？
而对面的明烛却对他笑了笑，但那笑容，南宇辰却觉得有些陌生，师尊从来不会露出这种……怎么说呢，像含着钩子似的，又软又带着几分说不清的妖艳。
对面的明烛，语气里带着一丝慵懒的意外，
“哎呀，我偶尔也会出来走走嘛。这小姑娘是我在附近捡到的，大约是哪家走丢的孩子，你也知道，这附近不安全……”
她说话间，随手解开了压在两人身上的灵力束缚。南宇辰和梁师兄终于喘着粗气站了起来。她又上下打量了他们一眼，语气带着几分长辈的关心，
“刚刚看她被攻击，我以为是什么天魔或者妖兽呢，便直接出手了，你们两人没伤着吧？”
梁师兄面对一位真君，大气都不敢出，只得转头看向南宇辰，毕竟这是人家的师父。
谁知南宇辰竟然直接开口道，
“你……你真是师尊？”
“宇辰，”对方微微歪了歪头，语气带上了几分无奈，“方才出手确实急了点，误伤了你们俩，可你也不至于问出这种话吧。”
南宇辰的表情却变得更加坚定，
“龙师兄曾经说过，当排除了一切不可能的情况后，剩下的，不管再怎么离奇，那也是真相。”
听到“龙师兄”三个字，对面的明烛目光忽然亮了一瞬，表情也柔和了几分。
“什么意思？”
“师尊……她今天前往某个……秘境，不可能在这里的，连分身不可能。”
南宇辰绝对不会弄错，师尊明烛今天应该在白玉京的梦境世界中，和另一位真君，负责掌控宗门的一件火系法宝，这种事哪怕是元婴也需要全神贯注，不可能分一个分身跑到这地方来闲逛的。
话音未落，他已经悄悄将师尊留给他的那枚护身法宝扣在掌心，那里面封着明烛的全力一击。他一边后退，一边将法宝举在身前，语气决然，
“我不知道你是谁，但你不可能是师尊。”
话音刚落，他就拉着梁师兄后退数十丈，同时将护身法宝举起，一旦对方有异动，就立刻激发。

然而让他怎么也没想到的是，对面的明烛只是轻轻抬手，指尖一点，护身法宝上的灵光便骤然黯淡下去，其中的威力尚在，但却被锁住了。
南宇辰不可思议的看着这景象，这种事……应该只有师尊本人才能做到才对，难道她真是……但……这不可能啊。
正当他一脸惊愕时，对面的明烛却再度笑了笑，接着飘到二人身前，一脸语重心长又无奈道，
“唉……你这傻孩子，你师尊……或者你龙师兄就没告诉过你，遇到这种事时，先不要急着拆穿，想办法和对方虚与委蛇才对吗？”
听到这话，南宇辰和旁边的梁师兄都傻眼了，这是……主动承认自己是假的了？
“明烛”则继续说道，
“也算你运气好，碰到了我，要是其他和我差不多的敌人的话，你以为凭你手上这个玩意儿，能跑的掉？”
正当南宇辰还想再问时，“明烛”右手一挥，两人的眼神瞬间变得空洞，身体像被线牵着似的，乖乖走回到刚刚画好的阵图旁。
而“明烛”则抱着银发小女孩，消失在了原地。
几息过后，两人的眼神重新恢复清明，却像是完全忘了方才发生的一切。梁师兄茫然地低头看了看地上的阵图，语气自然得像什么都没发生，
“好了，阵法完成了，我们也赶紧回去吧，似乎拖慢了一点呢。”
南宇辰也立刻回道，
“是啊，可能是我们刚才光顾着聊天了，阵图画的慢了些，赶紧回去吧。”
很快，二人就踏着筋斗步飞快的往回赶去，而在他们走后没多久，“明烛”和银发女孩又再度出现在原地，她低头看了看怀里的女儿，语气带着几分显摆的意味，
“双双，怎么样？那个小哥哥可是娘的弟子哦。”
名叫双双的小女孩却毫不留情地拆了台，
content_en:
"Master! What...what on earth is going on?!"
Although the person in front of him was his master, Nan Yuchen was a little panicked at the moment. This was too abnormal. How could his master suddenly appear in such a barren mountain and be so close to a weird little girl?
Ming Zhu, who was opposite him, smiled at him, but Nan Yuchen felt that that smile was a little strange. The master would never show this kind of... How should I put it, like a hook in his mouth, soft and a bit indescribably coquettish.
Ming Zhu, who was opposite, had a hint of lazy surprise in his tone.
"Oh, I occasionally go out for a walk. I picked up this little girl nearby. She was probably a lost child from some family. As you know, it's not safe here..."
As she spoke, she casually released the spiritual restraints on the two of them. Nan Yuchen and Senior Brother Liang finally stood up with heavy breaths. She looked them up and down again, with a hint of elder concern in her tone.
"I just saw her being attacked. I thought it was some kind of demon or monster, so I took action directly. Are you two injured?"
Senior Brother Liang didn't dare to express his anger when facing a true king. He had to turn his head and look at Nan Yuchen. After all, this was his master.
Unexpectedly, Nan Yuchen actually said directly,
"You...are you really Master?"
"Yuchen," the other party tilted his head slightly, with a hint of helplessness in his tone, "I did act too hastily just now and accidentally hurt you both, but you wouldn't ask such a question."
Nan Yuchen's expression became more determined,
"Senior Brother Long once said that after eliminating all impossible situations, whatever remains, no matter how bizarre, is the truth."
Upon hearing the words "Senior Brother Long", Mingzhu's eyes across from him suddenly brightened for a moment, and his expression softened a bit.
"What do you mean?"
"Master...she is going to a certain...secret place today. It is impossible to be here. It is impossible to even have a clone."
Nan Yuchen was absolutely unmistakable. Master Mingzhu should be in Bai Yujing's dream world today, and he and another True Lord were responsible for controlling a fire magic weapon of the sect. This kind of thing requires even the Nascent Soul to concentrate on it, and it is impossible for a clone to wander around here.
Before he finished speaking, he had quietly clasped the protective magic weapon left to him by his master in his palm, which contained Mingzhu's full blow. As he backed away, he held the magic weapon in front of him and spoke decisively,
"I don't know who you are, but you can't be Master."
As soon as he finished speaking, he pulled Senior Brother Liang back dozens of feet, and at the same time raised the protective magic weapon. Once the other party made any change, he would activate it immediately.
However, what he never expected was that the Mingzhu opposite him just raised his hand slightly, with a touch of his fingertips, the spiritual light on the protective magic weapon suddenly dimmed. The power in it was still there, but it was locked.
Nan Yuchen looked at this scene in disbelief. This kind of thing... only the master himself should be able to do it. Could it be that she really... but... this is impossible.
Just when he looked shocked, Mingzhu opposite him smiled again, then floated in front of the two of them, and said with a serious and helpless face,
"Sigh... you silly boy, your master... or your senior brother Long never told you that when you encounter this kind of thing, you should not rush to expose it first and find a way to make excuses with the other party, right?"
Hearing this, Nan Yuchen and Senior Brother Liang next to him were dumbfounded. Is this... taking the initiative to admit that he is a lie?
"Mingzhu" continued,
"You're lucky to have met me. If there were other enemies similar to mine, do you think you could escape with this thing in your hand?"
Just when Nan Yuchen wanted to ask again, "Mingzhu" waved his right hand, and their eyes instantly became empty. Their bodies seemed to be led by threads, and they obediently walked back to the formation diagram they had just drawn.
"Mingzhu" hugged the silver-haired little girl and disappeared.
After a few breaths, the eyes of the two regained theirAfter returning to Qingming, it seemed that he had completely forgotten everything that had just happened. Senior Brother Liang looked down at the formation diagram on the ground blankly, and his tone was as natural as if nothing happened.
"Okay, the formation is completed, let's go back quickly, it seems to be a little slow."
Nan Yuchen immediately replied,
"Yeah, maybe we were busy chatting just now, so the formation drawing was a little slow. Let's go back quickly."
Soon, the two of them hurried back in somersaults, and not long after they left, "Mingzhu" and the silver-haired girl appeared again. She looked down at her daughter in her arms, and her tone was a bit showy,
"Shuangshuang, how are you? That little brother is my disciple."
The little girl named Shuangshuang ruthlessly destroyed the situation.
